Yet another Corsair board I won't be buying! Featuring new Cherry MX switches!

They've done that 'thing' where the product gets cheaper but the price stays the same. Aluminium casing and some media keys have been replaced by more flashy lights... and it's $150.

Those new switches look interesting though, the image it gives you looks like it has two stems. I presume they've used a more complicated version of these to quieten the insides and added multiple tappets instead of one single beam.

EDIT: Cherry official posted this 3D model about a month ago. the switch has a TPE piece that sits inside the stem, this is what absorbes the noise going down and up as this piece hits the bottom and top rather than the plastic stem.

The switch looks interesting, but that's about where my interest ends. Non-standard layout once again, only this time with a much uglier font to exacerbate the fact that getting new caps will be a total bitch.

I'm not sure why Razer and Corsair are so insistent on pushing against what has become industry standard, it's only hurting them in the long run. It's the reason I'm selling/don't ever use my K70 RGB, and I'm sure I'm not alone.
